Remark
[normal coordinates and the Christoffel symbols]

Source: petersen:page-0085 ↗ def:pet-ch2-normal-coordinates-frame ↗ def:pet-ch2-christoffel-symbols-second-kind

In coordinates normal at $p$ (subsection 2.1), $g_{ij}|_p=\delta _{ij}$ and $\Gamma ^k_{ij}|_p=0$; consequently, at $p$, the covariant derivative is computed exactly as in Euclidean space: $(\nabla _YX)|_p=\big(Y^i\partial _i(X^j)\big)|_p\, \partial _j|_p$.
